pli-tv-kd13:1.1.5: bhikkhū → idaṃ te bhikkhūti padadvayaṃ yuropiyamarammapotthakesu na dissati.
pli-tv-kd13:1.2.6: bhante → yu. dutiyampi bhante. ma sohaṃ dutiyampi bhante.
pli-tv-kd13:1.2.8: bhante → yu. tatiyampi bhante. ma. sohi tatiyampi bhante.
pli-tv-kd13:2.1.6: bhikkhū → yu. ma. potthakesu te bhikkhūti padadvayaṃ na dissati.
pli-tv-kd13:7.3.17: mūlāya → ito paraṃ paṭikassanantipi paṭikassanātipi pāṭho aññesu potthakesu yebhuyyena dissati ṭhapetvā pālimttakavinayavinicchayaṃ. yadi paṭikassananti padaṃ paṭikassitoti pade kiriyāvisesanaṃ siyā taṃ abbhito saṅghena udāyi bhikkhūti abbhānapāliyā na sameti ettha abbhitoti padassa nikkiriyāvisesanattā. yadi paṭikassanāti padaṃ khamatīti pade kattāti gahetabbaṃ taṃ na yujjati aññesu kammesu khamatīti padassa kattuno adissamānarūpabhūtapbbattā. tasmā so dubbidho pāṭho ayuttarūpoyeva.
pli-tv-kd13:24.3.61: māsaparivāsassa → yuropiyapotthake itarampi māsaṃ parivāsassāti pāṭho āgato.
pli-tv-kd13:24.3.65: māsaparivāso → yu. itarampi māsaṃ parivāsoti pāṭho āgato.
pli-tv-kd13:26.1.2: so → yu. ma. potthakesu casaddo na dissati.
pli-tv-kd13:26.2.33: evañca → yu. ma. potthakesu casaddo na dissati.
pli-tv-kd13:34.2.5: uṭṭhite → uddhasteti pāṭho dissati. yuropiyarāmaññapotthakesu pana uddhateti pāṭho dissati.
pli-tv-kd13:36.1.54: āpattīhi → yuropiyamarammapotthakesu idaṃ visuddhinavakaṃ na dissati.
pli-tv-kd13:36.2.9: tasmiṃ → tassaṃ. | purimāāpattīnaṃ → yu. ma. purimānaṃ āpattīnaṃ.
pli-tv-kd13:36.4.46: āpattīhīti → yu. ma. potthakesu āgatapāṭho iminā asadaso. ñātuṃ icchantena tāni dve potthakāni oloketabbāni.
pli-tv-kd13:36.4.55: parimāṇā → yu. ma. pañcāha ca pakkhadasānaṃ āpattimāha mahāmuni. suddhanto ca vibbhanto parimāṇamukhaṃ.
pli-tv-kd13:36.4.61: chādeti → yu. ma. potthakesu na chādetīti pāṭho na dissati.
pli-tv-kd13:36.4.63: ummattakadesanañceva → yu. ma. potthakesu ayaṃ evasaddo natthi.
pli-tv-kd13:36.4.64: visuddhito → yu. ma. mūlā pannarasa visuddhito.
